mapper.sql: d.id=#{documentId} and d.document_type='textbook' and d.del_flag='0' and d.create_by=#{visibleUserId}
mapper.select: select d.id document_id,d.title,d.status,p.object_key,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.file_hash,p.uploaded_by,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d left join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id where

select d.id document_id,d.title,d.status,p.object_key,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.file_hash,p.uploaded_by,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d left join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id where for update of d

select d.id document_id,d.title,d.status,p.object_key,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.file_hash,p.uploaded_by,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id where d.document_type='textbook' and d.status='published' and d.del_flag='0' and d.id=#{documentId} and d.certification_id=(select g.certification_id from cm_user_goal g where g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active' order by g.update_time desc,g.id desc limit 1)

select cast(d.id as varchar) id,d.title,d.edition,sv.version_name syllabus_version_name,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=d.syllabus_version_id where d.document_type='textbook' and d.status='published' and d.del_flag='0' and d.certification_id=(select g.certification_id from cm_user_goal g where g.user_id=#{userId} and g.status='active' order by g.update_time desc,g.id desc limit 1) and d.title ilike concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by d.update_time desc,d.id desc
select cast(c.id as varchar) id,c.certification_name name from cm_exam_certification c where c.status='0' order by c.certification_name,c.id

select cast(d.id as varchar) id,d.title,d.edition,sv.version_name syllabus_version_name,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id join cm_exam_certification c on c.id=d.certification_id and c.status='0' left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=d.syllabus_version_id where d.document_type='textbook' and d.status='published' and d.del_flag='0' and d.certification_id=#{certificationId} and d.title ilike concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by d.update_time desc,d.id desc

select d.id document_id,d.title,d.status,p.object_key,p.file_name,p.file_size,p.file_hash,p.uploaded_by,p.uploaded_time from cm_document d join cm_textbook_original_pdf p on p.document_id=d.id join cm_exam_certification c on c.id=d.certification_id and c.status='0' where d.document_type='textbook' and d.status='published' and d.del_flag='0' and d.id=#{documentId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_textbook_original_pdf(id,document_id,object_key,file_name,file_size,file_hash,uploaded_by,uploaded_time,create_time,update_time) values(#{id},#{documentId},#{objectKey},#{fileName},#{fileSize},#{fileHash},#{userId},now(),now(),now()) on conflict(document_id) do update set object_key=excluded.object_key,file_name=excluded.file_name,file_size=excluded.file_size, file_hash=excluded.file_hash,uploaded_by=excluded.uploaded_by,uploaded_time=now(),update_time=now()
